name: FireFlow
author: Bastian Tonk
description: Modulation-first ambient groovebox: the FireFlow engine as a VCV Rack module.

modules.name: FireFlow
modules.description: Two SuperModulators (five lanes each), center section, ambient reverb, master drive.

modules.name: FireFlow Glow
modules.description: The flow machine on a Synthux Touch 2 surface: twelve places on twelve pads, six macro trim knobs, two assignable faders, two assignable switches.

modules.name: FireFlow HW Draft
modules.description: 60 HP hardware-envelope draft of the full instrument: static labels, real knob clearances, no LED rings. The regrouping workbench, not a release module.
